name: Minamoto no Shigeyuki
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 48); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 963.

poems.title: The waves that dash against the rocks
poems.author: Minamoto no Shigeyuki
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 48
poems.text:
The waves that dash against the rocks
Are broken by the wind
And turned to spray; my loving heart
Is broken too, I find,
Since thou art so unkind.

poems.title: 48. 風をいたみ 岩うつ浪の おのれのみ (Kaze o itami iwa utsu nami no onore nomi)
poems.author: Minamoto no Shigeyuki
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 詞花集
poems.text:
風をいたみ 岩うつ浪の おのれのみ
砕けてものを 思ふ頃かな
